en.headline: MUJI marks 25 years in Hong Kong with free exhibition at Man Yee Building
en.dek: The exhibition runs until 29 November in the first-floor atrium of the Central mall, featuring a large Ferris-wheel installation and a reaction game for app members.
body: MUJI is marking its 25th year in Hong Kong with a free exhibition titled 「原點．源於 無印良品」 at the first-floor atrium of Man Yee Building in Central.

The exhibition opened on 6 November and runs daily from 10.30am to 8.30pm until 29 November. It includes a large Ferris-wheel installation inspired by the Central landmark and displays tracing the brand's milestones since it first arrived in the city in 2001.

App members can take part in a free reaction game that awards a limited-edition plush keychain if they stop the timer on 2.50 seconds. Members who spend at least HK$100 at the new Man Yee store on the same day can also receive a free four-photo strip at the exhibition. Stocks are limited each day.
MUJI's 25th Hong Kong store, on the second floor of the same building, opened on 6 November. The organisers said the exhibition is free to enter and no booking is required.

zh.headline: 無印良品香港二十五周年 中環萬宜大廈免費展覽至十一月二十九日
zh.dek: 「原點．源於 無印良品」展覽在中環萬宜大廈商場一樓中庭舉行，設巨型摩天輪裝置，會員可參與反應遊戲。
body: 無印良品為紀念進駐香港二十五周年，在中環萬宜大廈商場一樓中庭舉行免費主題展覽「原點．源於 無印良品」。
展覽由十一月六日開始，每日上午十時半至晚上八時半，至十一月二十九日結束。場內設以中環摩天輪為靈感的大型裝置，並展示品牌自二〇〇一年進駐香港以來的重要時刻。
無印良品應用程式會員可免費參與「剛剛好的二點五」反應遊戲，成功停在二點五〇秒可獲限定毛絨掛飾匙扣。會員於同一天在萬宜新店消費滿一百元，亦可免費拍攝人生四格照。每日數量有限。
品牌香港第二十五間分店於十一月六日在同大廈二樓開業。主辦單位表示展覽免費入場，毋須預約。
